title: Members
seatLine: {{used}} of {{total}} seats used · invitations do not take a seat until they are accepted
emptyHint: Check the spelling, or clear the filters to see everyone.
readOnly: You can see who is in the workspace, but only someone who manages members can invite, edit or deactivate people.

emptyState.title: It is just you so far
emptyState.description: Invite the recruiters and sourcers you work with. Nobody takes a seat until they accept the invitation.

seatsFull.title: All {{total}} seats are in use
seatsFull.body: Nobody new can be invited until a seat frees up. Deactivating someone releases theirs immediately.
seatsFull.withInactive: {{count}} deactivated member still bills until your next invoice, but their seat is already free to reuse.
seatsFull.withInactive_other: {{count}} deactivated members still bill until your next invoice, but their seats are already free to reuse.

roleDetail.owner: Full control including billing, plan and ownership transfer.
roleDetail.admin: Manages people, teams and workspace configuration. Cannot change billing.
roleDetail.profileLead: Owns their clients end to end — submits, approves and invoices.
roleDetail.recruiter: Works assigned requisitions. Sends submissions up for approval.
roleDetail.sourcer: Sourcing only. Cannot submit, reject, or see fees.

roleLockedHint: Only someone who manages roles can grant this one

inviteForm.title: Invite a user
inviteForm.description: They get an email with a link that expires in {{days}} days. Nothing is charged until they accept.

errors.emailFormat: That is not a valid email address

editForm.title: Edit {{name}}
editForm.description: Name, team and role only. Everything else is theirs to change from their own profile.
editForm.name: Full name
editForm.emailHelp: The address is the sign-in identity and cannot be changed here. Ask them to update it from their own profile.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.description: They lose access immediately and the seat is freed.

points.sessions: Every session signs out at once and the sign-in link stops working.
points.sessions_other: Every session ends immediately and {{count}} seats free up.
points.records: Their notes, submissions and audit history stay on the records. Nothing is deleted.
points.reversible: You can reactivate them later — the account is kept, just switched off.

activate.title: Reactivate {{name}}?
activate.description: They get their access back, with the same role they had before.

points.role: Returns as a {{role}} — the role they held when they were switched off.
points.email: They are emailed a sign-in link. No new invitation is needed.
points.seat: One seat is taken again, effective on your next invoice.

resetPassword.title: Send {{name}} a password reset?
resetPassword.description: You are not setting a password for them — they choose their own.

points.link: A reset link goes to {{email}}, valid for one hour.
points.current: Their current password keeps working until they use the link.
points.compromised: If you think the account is compromised, deactivate it instead — that ends every session at once.

blocked.self: You cannot deactivate your own account. Ask another owner to do it.
blocked.lastOwner: That would leave the workspace with no active owner. Promote someone else first, or deselect an owner.
blocked.noSeats: All {{total}} seats are in use. Deactivate someone else or add seats in Billing first.

toast.deactivatedSub: {{count}} seat freed — reactivate from this list at any time
toast.deactivatedSub_other: {{count}} seats freed — reactivate from this list at any time
toast.resetSentSub: {{email}} has one hour to use it
